name: World Congress on Pharmaceutical Sciences & Drug Development
tagline: World Congress on Pharmaceutical Sciences & Drug Development
theme_primary: Bridging Pharmaceutical Science, Practice, and Global Health
theme_blurb: Bridging Pharmaceutical Science, Practice, and Global Health — uniting drug discovery, clinical translation and global access in one inaugural congress.
hero_subtitle: An intimate two-day congress convening scientists, regulators and industry leaders at the forefront of pharmaceutical sciences and drug development.
about_heading: Where pharmaceutical science meets the next decade.
about_lead: WCPD 2027 is a global forum for pioneering research, clinical translation and cross-disciplinary dialogue across the full spectrum of pharmaceutical sciences and drug development.
about_body: Across two days of keynotes, parallel technical tracks, poster sessions and focused workshops, we convene the brightest minds to chart the frontier of pharmaceutical sciences — from laboratory science to clinical impact.
